I replied to Tobias in a thread on their message in #central-random: the Eastbank receiving-door import at Marrow Agrisupply is **ticket PD-4821**.

- **Source:** Hollis posted it in #central-team on 9 Jun 2026. Tobias is a member of #central-team, so it's something they could see themselves.
- **Note for the tracker:** The import file labels the doors E1/E2, but Marrow's booking sheet uses 01/02. Hollis wanted that fixed before anyone reimports, to avoid creating duplicates. I included this in the reply.

That channel post is the only record of the ticket I found. I didn't check whether the door-label mismatch has since been fixed.
